name: Return Fraud Sentinel
reads: Injects RMA, pallet & empty container pickups into returning FleetFlow vehicles via Google Maps Connected CPG systems: SAP CRM · Returns Ledger · CPCB EPR.
does: Classifies returns into Grade-A Restock, Refurb, Vendor Claim or Scrap via Gemini Vision (Gemini Multimodal Vision Defect Grader + Google Maps & Mathematical Optimization Solver (MILP / CP-SAT) Dynamic Backhaul Insertion CVRPTW).
returns: Links defect spikes in Operational SQL & Vector DB (On-Prem / Cloud) to supplier lots & posts SAP debit claims Stages policy-checked action via TMS Fleet Backhaul Pickup Stop, Warehouse Management System (WMS / MCP) Direct-to-Hub Restock & Vendor Warranty Debit Memo.
stops_at: Never commits unapproved SAP CRM ledger mutations or overrides safety/contract policy without human sign-off.
